text:
Andrew: Kicking off a cross-zone staggered rollout for release v2.4.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploybot will ramp slices 1/10 -> 3/10, holdpoints at each region. Rolling window: 22:00-02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: starting canary slice 1/10 in us-west (us) for release v2.4.1

Mira: quick capacity check before we warm-up EU. what's headroom in us-west now?

Kevin: us-west pool metrics: CPU/GPU headroom ~18%, free slots 42/250, p95 latency 72ms, 5xx 0.03% last 5m.

Kevin: run: `opsctl region-metrics --region us-west --lookback 5m` ->
```
us-west: free_slots=42/250, gpu_util=62%, p95=72ms, 5xx_rate=0.0003
```

Mira: good. can we proceed to EU warmup with same model variant? any quantization diffs to be aware of?

Andrew: EU will be pinned to `model-v2-q4` for now due to slight perf differences on our EU hardware. note in the release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.4.1

SRE Oncall: rollback triggers for this roll: 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained 3m OR p95 > 800ms sustained 5m -> full rollback to v2.4.0. Notify #eng-oncall if triggered. Also keep an eye on warm-pool evictions.

canary-bot: us-west slice 1/10 smoke: 0 errors, 0.02% 5xx, p95 70ms, throughput ok. holding 10m.

Jen: posting release notes and changelog; tagging product in the thread. @product: FYI canary green in US.

deploy-bot: advancing EU canary slice 1/8 (pinned `model-v2-q4`). Starting warmups.

Kevin: EU warmup metrics: free_slots 30/120, gpu_util 68%, p95 85ms, 5xx 0.04% -> headroom looks fine. 

Mira: thumbs. proceed to staged ramp to 3/8 in EU after 12m hold.

SRE Oncall: noticed APAC warm-pool evictions trending up on the preflight sim (not live). If APAC warm-pool evictions > 5/min during ramp, throttle new slices to 50% and alert.

Andrew: noted — APAC will have a slower ramp and we won't auto-advance without manual ack.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 3/8 complete. No rollback triggers. Will await manual go for APAC.

canary-bot: EU smoke: 5xx 0.04%, p95 88ms, no regressions vs baseline.

Kevin: quick cmd if you need to re-check capacity: `./ops/check_capacity --region apac --window 10m`.

Jen: tagging infra for APAC manual go. @infra-team can you confirm warm-pool cushion in apac-sg?

infra-team: apac-sg cushion 12 slots / 80, eviction rate baseline 0.8/min.

Mira: ok holding. we'll wait 15m and then manual advance to APAC slice 1/6.

Andrew: all good. thanks everyone, please keep this thread updated. :thumbsup: 

SRE Oncall: if anything spikes, use `deploy-bot rollback region=apac` or `deploy-bot pin region=eu version=v2.4.0` — both are tested commands.

Jen: archived release notes link in #releases too. :white_check_mark: 

Kevin: final check before we proceed to APAC: run `opsctl region-metrics --region apac --lookback 10m` and paste results here.

infra-team: apac: free_slots=12/80, gpu_util=78%, p95=110ms, 5xx=0.06% (baseline simulation). recommend 10m extra hold.

Andrew: pausing rollout to APAC for the 10m extra hold. will reconvene here after hold.

(10 minutes later)

canary-bot: APAC slice 1/6 started. initial smoke: p95 115ms, 5xx 0.05% — holding 10m.

Mira: thanks. proceeding cautiously. back to you all in 15.

Jen: leaving a note for post-mortem checklist: document pin in EU, throttle guidance, rollback triggers.

Andrew: closing thread for now — will create follow-up if we hit any triggers. :partyparrot:
